sources.articleTitle: US officials seek ‘final end’ to Russia-Ukraine war as Abu Dhabi talks begin
US, Russia and Ukraine to restart talks in Abu Dhabi

headline: United States Russia And Ukraine Convene Peace Talks In Abu Dhabi
seoTitle: US Russia And Ukraine Begin Peace Talks In Abu Dhabi
metaDescription: Representatives from the United States, Russia, and Ukraine have begun peace negotiations in Abu Dhabi to address the long-running conflict.
aiSummaryBullets: The United States, Russia, and Ukraine have initiated trilateral peace negotiations in Abu Dhabi.
These represent the first substantive diplomatic discussions between the involved parties since February.
United States officials indicated an objective to secure a permanent resolution to the ongoing conflict.
aiContextParagraph: Diplomatic efforts to resolve the conflict between Russia and Ukraine have resumed with trilateral talks held in Abu Dhabi. This meeting marks the first significant round of negotiations since February. According to reporting from international outlets, representatives from the United States are participating alongside officials from both Russia and Ukraine. United States officials have stated their intention to pursue a comprehensive and permanent end to the hostilities. Furthermore, part of the American proposal involves the establishment of a long-term security architecture intended to govern relations between Moscow and European nations. While the situation remains in the early stages, the involvement of United States diplomatic personnel represents a shift in engagement levels compared to recent months. No additional details regarding the specific terms of the proposed security arrangements have been confirmed at this time as the discussions get underway in the United Arab Emirates.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to the high-level diplomatic involvement of the United States in the first major peace talks since February, reaching a moderate viral activity score across multiple independent outlets.
